fields.statement: Daemon watchdog scope: bug requests 01M6W8KN (retry a step once on a vanished go $WORK), 01M6W9VN (plan workflow reruns failed CI once) and 01M6WBVX (ship-change merges main on a rebase conflict) each add one recovery inside a workflow step. How should the watchdog relate to them? / When a run's step has had no journal entry or session report for longer than its limit, what does the watchdog do? / A run's PR has no CI (it conflicts with main) or is green but its run never merged it. What does the watchdog do? / Which shipped defaults should the watchdog's rhiza.toml policy have?
